subject: Renewal kickoff and QBR availability — Veridian Health subscription
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff and QBR availability — Veridian Health subscription

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. Per our roadmap, your current commitment comes up for renewal in late July, so I wanted to kick off the renewal + expansion planning early to make sure we have runway for any capacity increases and procurement timing.

Quick summary / proposed next steps:
- Timeline: target contract effective date 2026-07-25; aim to finish commercial & legal by 2026-07-15 so procurement has time for PO.
- Capacity ask: please confirm expected peak monthly token volume and any anticipated burst windows (Ben is copied to size Dedicated capacity if needed).
- Commercial: we plan to propose a stepped commit with a 10% uplift and an optional burst buffer — Marissa will lead the QBR and renewal presentation.
- QBR: please complete the calendar poll (link below) with availability for an executive QBR week of 2026-06-21.
- Procurement: copy your procurement contact so we can align on lead times and required paperwork.

Attachments: I attached a draft mutual action plan (Veridian_MAP_v1.xlsx) and an initial SOW for the uplift (proposed_sow_redwood_v1.pdf).

Can you confirm:
1) Who on your side owns procurement (name + email)?
2) Rough forecast for next 12 months (high/med/low or an expected % growth)?
3) Any deals/projects that will materially change usage in Q3 (e.g., new product launch)?

If it helps, I can also propose two renewal paths: staged uplift (step increases over 6 months) or single commit (larger immediate uplift) — Ben can run cost/unit comparisons once we have the forecast.

Calendar poll: https://calendar.google.com/poll?uid=veridian-qbr-2026-06

Thank you — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com
attachment: Veridian_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
attachment: proposed_sow_redwood_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff and QBR availability — Veridian Health subscription

Hi Chloe —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Appreciate the proactive timing. A few quick answers:
- Procurement is procurement@veridianhealth.com (copied). Alan Park is the lead there (alan.park@veridianhealth.com).
- Forecast: between now and July we expect a ~15% increase on core inference traffic due to a pilot rolling to production. By end of year we’re budgeting ~45% year-over-year growth but we’ll confirm with numbers by mid-June.
- No major launches planned before Q3 kickoff besides the pilot mentioned.

QBR availability: I filled the poll and marked 6/22 and 6/24 as preferred. If you could lock a 45–60 minute slot for the exec QBR that would be great.

On pricing — can you confirm whether the stepped uplift option includes a built-in discount band for the higher commit tier, or if that would require a separate commercial memo?

Best,
Sam
Director of Engineering | Veridian Health
sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff and QBR availability — Veridian Health subscription

Sam —

Great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for adding Alan.

Notes/next steps from our side:
- Pricing: stepped uplift includes a pre-agreed discount band tied to commit volume; Marissa will share a short pricing scenario matrix ahead of the QBR so you can see unit economics for staged vs single-commit paths.
- Capacity sizing: Ben will run a Dedicated sizing assessment once you confirm the 12-month forecast. Ben — can you validate whether a 15% near-term uplift keeps Veridian on hosted or if we should propose a Dedicated pool with burst capacity?
- QBR: Marissa will own the deck (exec summary, usage trends, recommended commit path). Tessa (CS) is looped for onboarding/enablement items post-signing.
- Procurement: Alan/procurement — we’re happy to surface an initial commercial term sheet and a redline-friendly SOW; typical timeline from signature to PO is ~2 weeks but we’ll build contingency into our target dates.

I’ll plan to schedule a 60-minute QBR on 2026-06-22 at 10:00 AM PT based on the poll unless you ask to reschedule — please confirm.

Marissa will send the pricing scenarios by EOD 2026-06-09. Ben, can you provide a high-level cost delta for hosted vs dedicated by EOD 2026-06-09 as well?

Thanks —
Chloe
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com

From: procurement@veridianhealth.com <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff and QBR availability — Veridian Health subscription

Hi Chloe / Marissa —

Alan here (procurement). Quick things from our side to keep the timeline moving:
- Typical PO timeline is 7–10 business days once commercial terms are agreed. We’ll need: final SOW, quote/invoice, and a contact for our security review.
- Please include a short SOC 2 summary and a data processing addendum (DPA). You can link the SOC 2 summary in the thread if easier.
- We also have a preferred vendor form — I’ll send that after the QBR if we proceed.

Confirming the QBR slot on 2026-06-22 at 10:00 AM PT works for procurement to attend.

Best,
Alan Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Veridian Health
alan.park@veridianhealth.com
